# FOSSStudio

> FOSSStudio is a free, open-source, self-hosted video studio for
> podcasts and meetings (AGPL-3.0) by Lightmorphic Ltd. Guests join by
> link with no account and no email address, up to ten in a room, with
> no charge per seat and no time limit on a session; a track per person
> recorded in their own browser and handed over exactly as recorded,
> plus one video of everyone that matches what was on screen; a
> view-only output link that works as an OBS browser source; one-paste
> Docker Compose install. No database, no trackers, no analytics, no
> crash reporting, no update check, no call to any domain but your own,
> and nothing on the server that opens a recording. Two things leave
> only when the operator asks: pressing Publish sends a recording to
> the operator's own FOSSCast address, and desktop notifications travel
> through the browser maker's push service. It records people talking
> and hands you the files: it does not publish a podcast, does not
> broadcast, does not edit, and has no screen sharing.

Version 0.1.0, a public beta. It is not ready to be relied on: data loss
and breaking changes are possible, and nobody should put a show or a
meeting they cannot record again on it yet. Releases are marked as
pre-release on GitHub.

- Home: https://fossstudio.org/
- Source and README: https://github.com/lightmorphic/fossstudio
- Sister project (podcast hosting and RSS): https://fosscast.org/

- Hosted, for people who would rather not run a server:
  https://castmorphic.com
